title: 30 dias de farm em 15 segundos
concept: A speedrun timer runs for the whole video and lands on 0:15.0 on the last frame; a split-flap day counter accelerates from DIA 01 to DIA 30 while one uniform bar per farmed day fills a chart, then RESULTADO DO RUN reveals a real customer print, '600kkzin pra conta' → 600KK no primeiro mês dele.

notes: The day chart is illustrative: every bar has the same height (one bar = one day farmed), no values. 600kk is in-game currency from the real print and is captioned 'no primeiro mês dele' (from the same print's first line). Per coordinator/ASSETS.md the full print is not shown because its first line names the legacy plan 'vip2'; the focus crop primeiro-mes-600kk--600kk.png ('600kkzin pra conta') is used instead, so the honest third line ('poderia ter feito mais, perdi tempo aprendendo') is not on screen. The run timer is 15.0 s over 14.85 s of animation so the final frame reads 0:15.0. No loop seam (the end frame is the 0:15.0 payoff).
